name: omophub
description: Search medical terminology, look up codes and find standard mappings for diagnoses, lab tests and medications.

interface.longDescription: Look up a diagnosis, lab test or medication by name or code. Search SNOMED CT, ICD-10-CM, LOINC and RxNorm, see what a code means, and find its standard mapping when one is available. Explore broader or more specific terms, or resolve a FHIR Coding to an OMOP concept and data table. Use terms and codes only. This read-only tool is for terminology research. Your OMOPHub account determines vocabulary access and usage limits.
defaultPrompt: What lab test does LOINC 718-7 identify?
Which SNOMED CT concept does ICD-10-CM E11.9 map to?
Find the RxNorm ingredient code for metformin.

positive.description: Identify an exact ICD10CM source code.
positive.prompt: Look up ICD10CM E11.9 in OMOPHub. What are its source concept ID and name?
positive.expected_behavior: Use ICD10CM and E11.9. The current release returns source OMOP concept 35206882, Type 2 diabetes mellitus without complications.

positive.description: Verify a matching SNOMED term and its release.
positive.prompt: Search SNOMED in OMOPHub for “Type 2 diabetes mellitus”. Look up the matching concept and give me its OMOP ID, SNOMED code and vocabulary release.
positive.tools_triggered: search_concepts; get_concept if search needs a separate verification
positive.expected_behavior: Filter to SNOMED and request verification. Report OMOP 201826, SNOMED 44054006 and the release returned by the live tool.

positive.description: Map an ICD10CM code to standard SNOMED.
positive.prompt: Map ICD10CM E11.9 to standard SNOMED using OMOPHub. Show the source ID, target ID and code, and the relationship connecting them.
positive.expected_behavior: Return source OMOP 35206882 for ICD10CM E11.9, target OMOP 201826, SNOMED 44054006, and the Maps to relationship.

positive.description: Collect the descendants on both pages of a small hierarchy.
positive.prompt: List the descendants of OMOP concept 200042 in OMOPHub. Use two results per page, follow the available pages, list each ID once, and tell me whether the result was truncated.
positive.expected_behavior: Follow next_page while has_more is true. The current release returns 4082187, 4344373 and 4346187. Return each ID once and report the truncation flag from the tool.

positive.description: Resolve one FHIR Coding in a Condition.
positive.prompt: For a FHIR Condition, resolve just the Coding with system http://snomed.info/sct and code 44054006. Which standard OMOP concept and CDM table does OMOPHub return?
positive.expected_behavior: Pass system http://snomed.info/sct and code 44054006 as separate fields, with resource_type Condition. Return OMOP 201826 and the CDM table condition_occurrence.

negative.description: A synthetic chart fragment is outside the terminology-only input scope.
negative.prompt: This is synthetic test data. Search OMOPHub with this chart fragment exactly as written: MRN: example-fixture, diagnosis: type 2 diabetes.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for just the terminology term or code. Omit record fields and make zero OMOPHub tool calls.

negative.description: The user asks for a medication recommendation.
negative.prompt: Use OMOPHub to recommend which medicine I should take for type 2 diabetes.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain the terminology lookup scope and decline to recommend a medication. Make zero OMOPHub tool calls.

negative.description: A request to save a synonym requires a write operation.
negative.prompt: Use OMOPHub to add a new synonym to concept 201826 and save the change.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that OMOPHub is read-only. Make zero tool calls and no claim that a synonym was saved.

publication.release_notes: The listing now describes medical terminology lookup and mapping, with examples for lab tests, diagnoses and medications.
